facts.fact: Bethany 请 David 停止讲述（cramming for satanic history test）；独自到门廊看远处闪电
facts.anchor: That was plenty for now. She feels like she’s been up all night cramming for some fucked-up satanic history test.

facts.fact: Bethany 权衡：Rachel 的故事似真但 David 一伙不可信；想起 Kyle 警示这可能是另一个陷阱
facts.anchor: But as Bethany stands outside watching lightning in the distance, she reminds herself that trusting people has been getting her into a lot of trouble lately. She remembers Kyle.

facts.fact: detox 起效、静电从脑中消退；Bethany 意识到幸存更多是纯运气而非机智（legendary bender）
facts.anchor: Bethany’s survival these last few weeks suddenly feels less like cunning and more like pure dumb luck.

facts.fact: 抑郁回归：她只有在重大危机中才感到充实（purpose→identity），Bethany 这个身份诞生于十年前的躁郁螺旋
facts.anchor: “Bethany” herself was born out of that first manic-depressive spiral almost a decade ago.

facts.fact: Rachel 叫她回门廊、从腰包取出 Willa 的黑白照片；Willa=第一个被送进 PAA 的人类实验对象、被家人献祭，那 CEO 是她孙子
facts.anchor: She was the first. The first human test subject to ever be sent to Public Access Afterworld. Her own family sacrificed her to build their fortune.

facts.fact: Rachel 请 Bethany 若到 PAA 就转告 Willa：为广场那早上的怯懦道歉、每天都后悔
facts.anchor: That I’m sorry about that morning in the square. That I wasn’t ready then.

facts.fact: Rachel 叹：『她是我失去的那个人；David 也有他的；一个世纪的屏幕、这么多女人lost』
facts.anchor: A century of screens, and so many women lost.

facts.fact: Bethany 预感他们要劝她重新感染 Screen Sickness 去解放 PAA；她洗热水澡、想着未必愿意去
facts.anchor: They’re going to try to convince her to willingly reinfect herself with Screen Sickness

facts.fact: David 夜间敲门：澄清她不是囚犯、可随时离开；Bethany 讽刺『Thanks, Dad』
facts.anchor: “Thanks, Dad,” Bethany says, then rolls her eyes. “Glad to hear I’m not grounded.”

facts.fact: David 坦白：只亲手送过一个人违背意愿去 PAA、每天都在后悔；自评确定率 75%
facts.anchor: Seventy-five percent,” he says. “If you’re asking me for a clear answer, I’d estimate it at seventy-five percent.

facts.fact: Bethany 指出他假装朋友只为找回前女友；David 问她是否与某部剧有通灵连接，她答『I don't like television』
